headline.purpose: Page identity only; never a vanity metric.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear next action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 14px; background: oklch(0.46 0.12 294); color: oklch(1 0 0); font: 650 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.40 0.13 294); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.70 0.13 294 / 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Routine action that does not compete with the primary path.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height: 38px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 14px; background: oklch(0.945 0.012 294); color: oklch(0.22 0.02 294); font: 650 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: oklch(0.91 0.015 294); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.70 0.13 294 / 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact operational input with explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: oklch(0.22 0.02 294); font: 650 12px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 260px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0.012 294); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.22 0.02 294); padding: 9px 10px; font: 400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.46 0.12 294); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.94 0.028 294); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Current destination in the quiet sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { width: 180px; min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 11px; text-align: left; background: oklch(0.94 0.028 294); color: oklch(0.46 0.12 294); font: 650 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: oklch(0.945 0.012 294); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.70 0.13 294 / 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Text-first state cue reinforced by semantic tone.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.94 0.028 294); color: oklch(0.46 0.12 294); font: 680 11px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Dispatch Panel
components.description: The sole high-contrast surface for batch limits and start action.
components.html: 下一批最多成功沟通 20 个职位达到 200 个候选职位或触发停机条件时结束。
components.css: .ds-dispatch { width: 460px; display: grid; gap: 8px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 28px; background: oklch(0.22 0.02 294); color: oklch(0.98 0.004 294); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dispatch small { color: oklch(0.74 0.07 294); font-size: 11px; } .ds-dispatch strong { font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-dispatch span { color: oklch(0.80 0.015 294); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: JobPilot feels like a carefully arranged desk for supervising consequential work: calm, legible, and continuously ready. The interface is a product surface, not a performance; automation state, risk, limits, and human control take precedence over decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained information density with strong alignment
Consequential actions separated from routine controls
State conveyed through text, shape, and color together

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Saturated dispatch indigo is limited to the current selection, the primary action, and active system state. It is never background decoration.

rules.name: The Three Consequences Rule
rules.body: Green confirms, amber requests attention, and red stops. Every use also carries a word, icon, or shape so color is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Operational Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings identify tasks and state; they never become oversized marketing statements. Labels use sentence case and remain readable at 200% zoom.

rules.name: The State Earns Depth Rule
rules.body: Resting content does not float. Elevation appears only when interaction or stacking requires it.

dos: Do keep current batch state and stop controls continuously visible in the 64px sticky operation bar.
Do explain risky actions in direct Chinese before the user confirms them.
Do use dispatch indigo on no more than ten percent of a screen.
Do preserve keyboard operation, visible focus, non-color state cues, 200% zoom, and reduced motion.
Do use restrained 120–180ms state transitions only for meaningful feedback.
donts: Don't resemble a traditional enterprise admin dashboard.
Don't use neon cyberpunk control rooms, AI gradients, glass effects, or decorative ‘agent thinking’ theatrics.
Don't introduce oversized vanity metrics, stacked card grids, or cards nested inside cards.
Don't use purple gradients; dispatch indigo is a sparse flat signal, never ambient decoration.
Don't make risky automation feel playful, frictionless, or reversible when it is not.
